name: Rosewood Sanya
positioning: Haitang Bay hotel with rooms and suites overlooking the South China Sea, a 13th-floor infinity pool and several restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want sea views from their room
Food lovers keen on fresh seafood and local Hainan flavors
Families who want a dedicated family pool

facts.text: Rosewood Sanya bills itself as the Beacon of Haitang Bay.
Rooms and suites have an intimate residential feel and look out over the South China Sea.
The Fishmonger is a market-style seafood restaurant with open kitchens serving the day's freshest catch.
Chop House is a seaside Italian grill.
East Kitchen is an Asian bistro serving comfort food inspired by Southeast Asian signature dishes.
The Lounge serves light bites, specialty cocktails, rare wines and craft beers.
There is a Family Pool and a Garden Pool on the first floor.
The spa is Senses, A Rosewood Spa, offering personalized treatments.
Guests can sail along Sanya's coastline aboard a super yacht.
Golf on Sanya's courses is offered as an experience.
Nanshan Temple, a Buddhist temple modeled on Tang Dynasty style, sits on a mountain overlooking the sea.

highlights.text: HAI-Infinity Pool & Bar is a poolside bar with panoramic ocean views and drinks crafted by a resident mixologist.
The infinity pool is on the 13th floor.
A Hainan Fire Dance, rooted in the harvest celebrations of Hainan's ethnic minorities, is staged at the Garden Pool.
The Fishmonger offers a Hainan hotpot with Puqian Zuopo Vinegar Broth.
Haitang House is an oceanfront accommodation with sea views.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the location requires travel time to reach downtown Sanya attractions.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the ultra-high-end positioning.
